mapper.select: SELECT a.instance_id as device_id, (CASE WHEN ISNULL( b.mete_name )AND ISNULL( c.inspection_id )AND ISNULL( d.preset_name ) THEN '' WHEN ISNULL( b.mete_name )AND ISNULL( c.inspection_name ) THEN d.preset_name WHEN ISNULL( b.mete_name ) AND ISNULL( d.preset_img ) THEN c.inspection_name WHEN ISNULL( c.inspection_name ) AND ISNULL( d.preset_name ) THEN b.mete_name WHEN ISNULL( c.inspection_name ) THEN CONCAT( b.mete_name, ' /', d.preset_name ) WHEN ISNULL( d.preset_name ) THEN CONCAT( b.mete_name, ' /', c.inspection_name ) END) AS device_name, f.custom_id as component_id, f.custom_name as component_name, f.up_region_id as bay_id, f.up_region_name as bay_name, f.device_id as main_device_id, f.device_name as main_device_name, j.up_dict as device_type, b.mete_type, b.appearance_type, "" as save_type_list, k.dict_note as recognition_type_list, "" as phase, "" as device_info, "" as data_type, "" as lower_value, "" as upper_value, "" as video_pos FROM t_cruise_point_instance a LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete b ON a.device_mete_id = b.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection c ON a.cruise_id = c.inspection_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset d ON a.cruise_id = d.preset_id left join t_std_device f on a.device_id = f.device_id and a.custom_id = f.custom_id left join t_dict_business j on f.device_type = j.dict_code left join t_dict_business k on a.cruise_type = k.dict_code

select IFNULL(a.robot_name,""), IFNULL(a.robot_code,""), IFNULL(c.dict_note,"") as manufacturer, IFNULL(b.up_dict,"") as type, IFNULL(a.remarks,"") as robot_info, if(b.dict_code=399,0,1) as istransport from t_robot_info a left join t_dict_business b on a.robot_type = b.dict_code left join t_dict_business c on a.robot_factory = c.dict_code

SELECT b.up_dict as type, a.task_id as task_code, a.task_name, a.task_level as priority, "3" as device_level, if(a.if_run=174,a.start_time,"") as fixed_start_time, IFNULL(a.date_type,"") as time, "" as cycle_month, "" as cycle_week, "" as cycle_execute_time, "" as cycle_start_time, "" as cycle_end_time, "" as interval_number, "" as interval_type, if(c.c_state=240,1,0) isenable, "" as creator, "" as create_time from t_cruise_task a left join t_dict_business b on a.type = b.dict_code and b.col_name="plan_type" left join t_cruise_result c on a.task_id = c.task_id
